mapper.select: select task_code, task_name, system_code, owner_name, supervisor_name, pre_requisite_prod, the_batch_prod, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, default_cost_minutes, pos_x, pos_y, is_flag, remark, created_time, updated_time from monitor_task order by system_code asc, task_code asc

select task_code, task_name, system_code, owner_name, supervisor_name, pre_requisite_prod, the_batch_prod, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, default_cost_minutes, pos_x, pos_y, is_flag, remark, created_time, updated_time from monitor_task where task_code = #{taskCode} limit 1
